item.text: The race is in the notification callback: before `turn/start` resolves, it immediately deduplicates and sums any response on the thread, so a stale turn can both add tokens and reserve a response ID. I’m changing that path to queue early raw responses, then replay them in arrival order through exact thread/turn filtering and first-observation deduplication once the returned turn ID is known.

I also added failure- and abort-path assertions so token usage attachment and `tokenUsageComplete` remain verified across all terminal outcomes.
